```{r}
N172010a <- read_csv("Data/N172010a.csv") %>%
  filter(`Year Code` < 2018)
N172018a <- read_csv("Data/N172018a.csv")
clean_year <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Year_raw = as.character(Year),
      # pull the first 4-digit year (e.g., "2024 (provisional)" -> 2024)
      Year = readr::parse_number(Year_raw),
      # keep any extra text as a note (optional)
      Year_note = str_squish(str_remove(Year_raw, "^\\d{4}"))
    )
}

N17a <- bind_rows(
  clean_year(N172010a ),
  clean_year(N172018a )
) %>%
  select(-Year_raw)

  filter(`Year Code` < 2018)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(tidyr)
})

# -----------------------------
# Helpers
# -----------------------------

parse_pop_safe <- function(x) {
  x <- na_if(as.character(x), "Not Applicable")
  readr::parse_number(x, na = c("", "NA", "Not Applicable"))
}

parse_rate_safe <- function(x) {
  x <- na_if(as.character(x), "Unreliable")
  x <- na_if(x, "Not Applicable")
  readr::parse_number(x, na = c("", "NA", "Unreliable", "Not Applicable"))
}

std_year <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(Year)),
      `Year Code` = suppressWarnings(as.integer(`Year Code`))
    )
}

coerce_rate_ci_cols <- function(df) {
  rate_cols <- c(
    "Crude Rate",
    "Crude Rate Lower 95% Confidence Interval",
    "Crude Rate Upper 95% Confidence Interval",
    "Age Adjusted Rate",
    "Age Adjusted Rate Lower 95% Confidence Interval",
    "Age Adjusted Rate Upper 95% Confidence Interval"
  )
  
  present <- intersect(rate_cols, names(df))
  
  df %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(present), ~ parse_rate_safe(.x)))
}

# -----------------------------
# Master standardizer
# -----------------------------
standardize_extract <- function(df, source_label) {
  
  # unify race columns if both exist
  if (all(c("Single Race 6", "Race") %in% names(df))) {
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        race      = coalesce(`Single Race 6`, Race),
        race_code = coalesce(`Single Race 6 Code`, `Race Code`)
      ) %>%
      select(-any_of(c("Single Race 6", "Single Race 6 Code",
                       "Race", "Race Code")))
  }
  
  df %>%
    std_year() %>%
    mutate(source = source_label) %>%
    mutate(
      Population = if ("Population" %in% names(.))
        parse_pop_safe(Population) else Population
    ) %>%
    coerce_rate_ci_cols() %>%
    # ensure missing stratifier columns exist
    mutate(
      Sex = if (!"Sex" %in% names(.)) NA_character_ else Sex,
      `Sex Code` = if (!"Sex Code" %in% names(.)) NA_character_ else `Sex Code`,
      race = if (!"race" %in% names(.)) NA_character_ else race,
      race_code = if (!"race_code" %in% names(.)) NA_character_ else race_code,
      `Five-Year Age Groups` = if (!"Five-Year Age Groups" %in% names(.))
        NA_character_ else `Five-Year Age Groups`,
      `Five-Year Age Groups Code` = if (!"Five-Year Age Groups Code" %in% names(.))
        NA_character_ else `Five-Year Age Groups Code`
    )
}
```

## YEAR table
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
})

# -----------------------------
# Race harmonizer
# -----------------------------
norm_race <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "American Indian or Alaska Native" ~ "American Indian or Alaska Native",
    x == "Asian" ~ "Asian",
    x == "Asian or Pacific Islander" ~ "Asian",
    x == "Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander" ~
      "Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander",
    x == "Black or African American" ~ "Black or African American",
    x == "White" ~ "White",
    x == "More than one race" ~ "More than one race",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# SEX deaths (2010–2025)
# -----------------------------
get_sex_totals <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(source == "sex",
           !is.na(Sex),
           Sex %in% c("Female","Male"),
           Year >= 2010, Year <= 2025) %>%
    group_by(Year, Sex) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Sex,
                values_from = n,
                values_fill = 0) %>%
    rename(
      `Women (n)` = Female,
      `Men (n)`   = Male
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      `Overall (n)` = `Women (n)` + `Men (n)`
    )
}

# -----------------------------
# RACE deaths
# -----------------------------
get_race_totals <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(source == "race",
           !is.na(race),
           Year >= 2010, Year <= 2025) %>%
    mutate(race_std = norm_race(race)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(race_std)) %>%
    group_by(Year, race_std) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(race_std = paste0(race_std," (n)")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = race_std,
                values_from = n,
                values_fill = 0)
}

# -----------------------------
# Population + Crude + AAMR
# pull from sex extract (one row per sex, same pop)
# -----------------------------
get_rates <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(source == "sex",
           !is.na(Sex),
           Sex == "Female",    # population same for both sexes
           Year >= 2010, Year <= 2025) %>%
    group_by(Year) %>%
    summarise(
      Population = max(Population, na.rm=TRUE),
      `Crude rate (/100,000)` = max(`Crude Rate`, na.rm=TRUE),
      `AAMR (/100,000), age-adjusted (all ages)` =
        max(`Age Adjusted Rate`, na.rm=TRUE),
      .groups="drop"
    )
}

# -----------------------------
# MASTER FUNCTION
# -----------------------------
make_total_table <- function(df, outcome_label){

  sex_tbl  <- get_sex_totals(df)
  race_tbl <- get_race_totals(df)
  rate_tbl <- get_rates(df)

  sex_tbl %>%
    left_join(race_tbl, by="Year") %>%
    left_join(rate_tbl, by="Year") %>%
    mutate(outcome = outcome_label) %>%
    select(
      outcome,
      Year,
      `Overall (n)`,
      `Women (n)`,
      `Men (n)`,
      `American Indian or Alaska Native (n)`,
      `Asian (n)`,
      `Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander (n)`,
      `Black or African American (n)`,
      `White (n)`,
      `More than one race (n)`,
      Population,
      `Crude rate (/100,000)`,
      `AAMR (/100,000), age-adjusted (all ages)`
    ) %>%
    arrange(Year)
}

# -----------------------------
# Build tables (2010–2025 only)
# -----------------------------
tbl_N17    <- make_year_table(N17_all,    "N17 (Renal failure)")
tbl_A40    <- make_year_table(A40_all,    "A40 (Sepsis)")
tbl_N17A40 <- make_year_table(N17A40_RF, "N17/A40")


```

```{r}
add_total_row <- function(tbl) {

  tbl2 <- tbl %>%
    mutate(Year = as.character(Year))

  ok <- is.finite(tbl2$Population) & tbl2$Population > 0 &
    is.finite(tbl2$`AAMR (/100,000), age-adjusted (all ages)`)

  wmean_aamr <- if (any(ok)) {
    sum(tbl2$`AAMR (/100,000), age-adjusted (all ages)`[ok] *
          tbl2$Population[ok]) /
      sum(tbl2$Population[ok])
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  total_row <- tbl2 %>%
    summarise(
      outcome = first(outcome),
      Year = "2010–2025",

      `Overall (n)` = sum(`Overall (n)`, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Women (n)`   = sum(`Women (n)`, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Men (n)`     = sum(`Men (n)`, na.rm = TRUE),

      `American Indian or Alaska Native (n)` =
        sum(`American Indian or Alaska Native (n)`, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Asian (n)` =
        sum(`Asian (n)`, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander (n)` =
        sum(`Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander (n)`, na.rm = TRUE),
      `Black or African American (n)` =
        sum(`Black or African American (n)`, na.rm = TRUE),
      `White (n)` =
        sum(`White (n)`, na.rm = TRUE),
      `More than one race (n)` =
        sum(`More than one race (n)`, na.rm = TRUE),

      Population = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),

      `Crude rate (/100,000)` =
        round(
          sum(`Overall (n)`, na.rm = TRUE) /
            sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) * 100000,
          2
        ),

      `AAMR (/100,000), age-adjusted (all ages)` =
        round(wmean_aamr, 2)
    )

  bind_rows(tbl2, total_row) %>%
    mutate(
      `Crude rate (/100,000)` =
        round(`Crude rate (/100,000)`, 2),
      `AAMR (/100,000), age-adjusted (all ages)` =
        round(`AAMR (/100,000), age-adjusted (all ages)`, 2)
    )
}

tbl_N17    <- add_total_row(tbl_N17)
tbl_A40    <- add_total_row(tbl_A40)
tbl_N17A40 <- add_total_row(tbl_N17A40)

tbl_N17
tbl_A40
tbl_N17A40
```
## Period Map

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Period summary table (Metric rows × Period columns)
# For N17_all, A40_all, N17A40_all (2010–2025)
# - Uses std2000_allages for direct standardization from age table
# - Fixes list-columns (<chr[2]>) by deduping totals and forcing
#   exactly 1 row per outcome×period before pivot_wider
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
})

# ============================================================
# 0) 2000 US standard weights (all ages; your version)
# ============================================================
std2000_allages <- tibble(
  age_code = c(
    "1","1-4",
    "5-9","10-14",
    "15-19","20-24",
    "25-29","30-34",
    "35-39","40-44",
    "45-49","50-54",
    "55-59","60-64",
    "65-69","70-74",
    "75-79","80-84",
    "85+"
  ),
  std_million = c(
    13818, 55317,
    145565/2, 145565/2,
    138646/2, 138646/2,
    135573/2, 135573/2,
    162613/2, 162613/2,
    134834/2, 134834/2,
    87247/2,  87247/2,
    66037/2,  66037/2,
    44842/2,  44842/2,
    15508
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    std_million = round(std_million),
    weight_all  = std_million / sum(std_million)
  )

# ============================================================
# 1) Period map (2010–2025)
# ============================================================
period_map <- function(year) {
  case_when(
    year >= 2010 & year <= 2019 ~ "Pre-pandemic (2010–2019)",
    year >= 2020 & year <= 2022 ~ "Pandemic (2020–2022)",
    year == 2023                ~ "Transition (2023)",
    year >= 2024 & year <= 2025 ~ "Post-pandemic (2024–2025)",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 2) Your age recode (collapse 85-89/90-94/95-99/100+ -> 85+)
#    (Safe even if your codes already have 85+)
# ============================================================
recode_to_std_age <- function(age_code) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    age_code %in% c("85-89", "90-94", "95-99", "100+") ~ "85+",
    TRUE ~ as.character(age_code)
  )
}

# ============================================================
# 3) Formatting helpers (2 decimals for rates)
# ============================================================
fmt_int <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, formatC(round(x), digits = 0, format = "f", big.mark = ","))
fmt_rate2 <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, formatC(x, digits = 2, format = "f", big.mark = ","))
fmt_n_pct <- function(n, denom, digits = 1) {
  ifelse(is.na(n) | is.na(denom) | denom == 0,
         NA_character_,
         paste0(fmt_int(n), " (", formatC(100*n/denom, digits = digits, format = "f"), "%)"))
}

# ============================================================
# 4) Direct-standardized AAMR from age table using std2000_allages
#    - If ages_keep provided, weights are renormalized within that band
# ============================================================
aamr_from_age <- function(age_df, ages_keep = NULL) {
  # age_df must contain: period, age_code, Deaths, Population
  w <- std2000_allages %>% select(age_code, weight_all)

  df <- age_df %>%
    left_join(w, by = "age_code") %>%
    filter(!is.na(weight_all))

  if (!is.null(ages_keep)) {
    df <- df %>% filter(age_code %in% ages_keep)
  }

  df <- df %>%
    group_by(period) %>%
    mutate(w_norm = weight_all / sum(weight_all, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(rate = ifelse(Population > 0, Deaths / Population * 100000, NA_real_))

  df %>%
    group_by(period) %>%
    summarise(AAMR = sum(rate * w_norm, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

# ============================================================
# 5) Period totals (deaths/pop/crude) from SEX table totals
#    FIX: dedupe "overall" per YEAR before summing to period
# ============================================================
# ---- period order
period_levels <- c(
  "Pre-pandemic (2010–2019)",
  "Pandemic (2020–2022)",
  "Transition (2023)",
  "Post-pandemic (2024–2025)"
)

# ============================================================
# A) Overall totals: deaths/pop/crude + OVERALL AAMR from WONDER AAR totals
#    (population-weighted mean of yearly AAR within each period)
# ============================================================
period_overall_totals <- function(df_all) {

  # pick ONE "overall" row per year
  yearly_overall <- df_all %>%
    mutate(period = period_map(Year)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(period), source == "sex") %>%
    filter(is.na(Sex) | Sex == "" | Notes == "Total" | str_to_lower(Sex) == "total") %>%
    mutate(overall_rank = ifelse(Notes == "Total", 1L, 2L)) %>%
    arrange(Year, overall_rank) %>%
    group_by(Year, period) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()

  yearly_overall %>%
    group_by(period) %>%
    summarise(
      total_deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      population   = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
      crude_rate   = ifelse(sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                            sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) * 100000,
                            NA_real_),
      # overall AAMR: population-weighted mean of yearly Age Adjusted Rate from WONDER totals
      AAMR_overall = ifelse(sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                            sum(`Age Adjusted Rate` * Population, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
                            NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# ============================================================
# B) Sex stats (female & male in one row per period)
# ============================================================
period_sex_stats <- function(df_all) {

  base <- df_all %>%
    mutate(period = period_map(Year)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(period), source == "sex") %>%
    mutate(
      Sex_chr  = str_trim(as.character(Sex)),
      Code_chr = str_trim(as.character(`Sex Code`)),
      Sex_std = case_when(
        str_to_lower(Sex_chr) %in% c("male", "m") ~ "Male",
        str_to_lower(Sex_chr) %in% c("female", "f") ~ "Female",
        Code_chr == "M" ~ "Male",
        Code_chr == "F" ~ "Female",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(Sex_std %in% c("Male", "Female"))

  female <- base %>%
    filter(Sex_std == "Female") %>%
    group_by(period) %>%
    summarise(
      Female_deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      Female_AAMR   = ifelse(sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                             sum(`Age Adjusted Rate` * Population, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
                             NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  male <- base %>%
    filter(Sex_std == "Male") %>%
    group_by(period) %>%
    summarise(
      Male_deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      Male_AAMR   = ifelse(sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                           sum(`Age Adjusted Rate` * Population, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
                           NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  full_join(female, male, by = "period")
}

# ============================================================
# C) Age-band AAMRs from age table using std weights (unchanged logic)
#    NOTE: this does NOT define overall AAMR anymore (only bands)
# ============================================================
period_age_aamr_blocks <- function(df_all) {

  age_df <- df_all %>%
    mutate(period = period_map(Year)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(period), source == "age") %>%
    transmute(
      period,
      age_code = recode_to_std_age(`Five-Year Age Groups Code`),
      Deaths,
      Population
    ) %>%
    group_by(period, age_code) %>%
    summarise(
      Deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      Population = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      age_band = case_when(
        age_code %in% c("1","1-4","5-9","10-14","15-19") ~ "<20",
        age_code %in% c("20-24","25-29","30-34","35-39","40-44") ~ "20–44",
        age_code %in% c("45-49","50-54","55-59","60-64") ~ "45–64",
        age_code %in% c("65-69","70-74","75-79","80-84","85+") ~ "65+",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(age_band)) %>%
    group_by(period, age_band) %>%
    summarise(
      deaths_band = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop_band    = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
      rate_band   = ifelse(pop_band > 0, deaths_band / pop_band * 100000, NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    select(period, age_band, rate_band) %>%
    mutate(
      col = case_when(
        age_band == "<20"   ~ "<20 AAMR (/100,000)",
        age_band == "20–44" ~ "20–44 AAMR (/100,000)",
        age_band == "45–64" ~ "45–64 AAMR (/100,000)",
        age_band == "65+"   ~ "65+ AAMR (/100,000)",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    select(period, col, rate_band) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = rate_band)

  age_df
}

# ============================================================
# D) Final table builder (Metric rows × Period cols, ordered)
# ============================================================
make_period_metric_table <- function(df_all, outcome_label) {

  overall_tot <- period_overall_totals(df_all)
  sex_stats   <- period_sex_stats(df_all)
  race_stats  <- period_race_aamr(df_all)
  age_blocks  <- period_age_aamr_blocks(df_all)

  wide <- overall_tot %>%
    left_join(sex_stats,  by = "period") %>%
    left_join(age_blocks, by = "period") %>%
    left_join(race_stats, by = "period") %>%
    mutate(outcome = outcome_label) %>%
    group_by(outcome, period) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), ~ dplyr::first(.x)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      Male_deaths   = coalesce(Male_deaths,   0),
      Female_deaths = coalesce(Female_deaths, 0)
    )

  wide_fmt <- wide %>%
    transmute(
      outcome,
      period,

      `Total deaths, n` = fmt_int(total_deaths),
      `Male deaths, n (%)` = fmt_n_pct(Male_deaths, total_deaths, digits = 1),
      `Female deaths, n (%)` = fmt_n_pct(Female_deaths, total_deaths, digits = 1),

      Population = fmt_int(population),
      `Crude mortality rate (/100,000)` = fmt_rate2(crude_rate),

      # ✅ overall AAMR from WONDER totals
      `AAMR (/100,000), age-adjusted (all ages)` = fmt_rate2(AAMR_overall),

      `Male AAMR (/100,000)` = fmt_rate2(Male_AAMR),
      `Female AAMR (/100,000)` = fmt_rate2(Female_AAMR),

      `<20 AAMR (/100,000)` = fmt_rate2(`<20 AAMR (/100,000)`),
      `20–44 AAMR (/100,000)` = fmt_rate2(`20–44 AAMR (/100,000)`),
      `45–64 AAMR (/100,000)` = fmt_rate2(`45–64 AAMR (/100,000)`),
      `65+ AAMR (/100,000)` = fmt_rate2(`65+ AAMR (/100,000)`),

      `American Indian or Alaska Native AAMR (/100,000)` =
        fmt_rate2(`American Indian or Alaska Native AAMR (/100,000)`),
      `Asian AAMR (/100,000)` =
        fmt_rate2(`Asian AAMR (/100,000)`),
      `Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander AAMR (/100,000)` =
        fmt_rate2(`Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander AAMR (/100,000)`),
      `Black or African American AAMR (/100,000)` =
        fmt_rate2(`Black or African American AAMR (/100,000)`),
      `White AAMR (/100,000)` =
        fmt_rate2(`White AAMR (/100,000)`),
      `More than one race AAMR (/100,000)` =
        fmt_rate2(`More than one race AAMR (/100,000)`)
    )

  metric_tbl <- wide_fmt %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -c(outcome, period), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(period = factor(period, levels = period_levels)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = period, values_from = value)

  metric_order <- c(
    "Total deaths, n",
    "Male deaths, n (%)",
    "Female deaths, n (%)",
    "Population",
    "Crude mortality rate (/100,000)",
    "AAMR (/100,000), age-adjusted (all ages)",
    "Male AAMR (/100,000)",
    "Female AAMR (/100,000)",
    "<20 AAMR (/100,000)",
    "20–44 AAMR (/100,000)",
    "45–64 AAMR (/100,000)",
    "65+ AAMR (/100,000)",
    "American Indian or Alaska Native AAMR (/100,000)",
    "Asian AAMR (/100,000)",
    "Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander AAMR (/100,000)",
    "Black or African American AAMR (/100,000)",
    "White AAMR (/100,000)",
    "More than one race AAMR (/100,000)"
  )

  metric_tbl %>%
    mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = metric_order)) %>%
    arrange(Metric) %>%
    mutate(Metric = as.character(Metric)) %>%
    select(outcome, Metric, all_of(period_levels))
}
# ============================================================
# 10) RUN for all three outcomes
#     (Assumes you already have: N17_all, A40_all, N17A40_all)
# ============================================================
tbl_period_N17    <- make_period_metric_table(N17_all,    "N17 (Renal failure)")
tbl_period_A40    <- make_period_metric_table(A40_all,    "A40 (Sepsis)")
tbl_period_N17A40 <- make_period_metric_table(N17A40_RF, "N17 & A40")
```

## Age
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
})

# ============================================================
# 0) helpers
# ============================================================
ageband_map <- function(age_code) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    age_code %in% c("1","1-4","5-9","10-14","15-19") ~ "lt20",
    age_code %in% c("20-24","25-29","30-34","35-39","40-44") ~ "20_44",
    age_code %in% c("45-49","50-54","55-59","60-64") ~ "45_64",
    age_code %in% c("65-69","70-74","75-79","80-84","85+") ~ "65_plus",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# --- deaths by YearKey × band (wide)
deaths_by_year_band <- function(df_all, prefix_name) {
  df_all %>%
    filter(source == "age") %>%
    transmute(
      YearKey    = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      age_code   = recode_to_std_age(`Five-Year Age Groups Code`),
      Deaths     = as.numeric(Deaths),
      Population = as.numeric(Population)
    ) %>%
    filter(YearKey >= 2010, YearKey <= 2025) %>%
    mutate(age_band = ageband_map(age_code)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(age_band)) %>%
    group_by(YearKey, age_band) %>%
    summarise(deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(col = paste0(prefix_name, "_deaths_", age_band)) %>%
    select(YearKey, col, deaths) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = deaths)
}

# --- age-band rates (per 100,000) by YearKey × band (wide)
rates_by_year_band <- function(df_all, prefix_name) {
  df_all %>%
    filter(source == "age") %>%
    transmute(
      YearKey    = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      age_code   = recode_to_std_age(`Five-Year Age Groups Code`),
      Deaths     = as.numeric(Deaths),
      Population = as.numeric(Population)
    ) %>%
    filter(YearKey >= 2010, YearKey <= 2025) %>%
    mutate(age_band = ageband_map(age_code)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(age_band)) %>%
    group_by(YearKey, age_band) %>%
    summarise(
      deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop    = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
      rate   = ifelse(pop > 0, deaths / pop * 100000, NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(col = paste0(prefix_name, "_AAMR_", age_band)) %>%  # keep your requested name
    select(YearKey, col, rate) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = rate)
}

# --- TOTAL row for deaths (sum across years)
add_total_row_deaths <- function(tbl, label = "2010–2025") {
  tbl2 <- tbl %>% mutate(YearKey = as.character(YearKey))

  total_row <- tbl2 %>%
    summarise(
      YearKey = label,
      across(-YearKey, ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
    )

  bind_rows(tbl2, total_row)
}


# --- TOTAL row for rates (recompute: sum deaths / sum pop across years)
rate_total_band <- function(df_all, prefix_name, label = "2010–2025") {
  df_all %>%
    filter(source == "age") %>%
    transmute(
      YearKey    = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      age_code   = recode_to_std_age(`Five-Year Age Groups Code`),
      Deaths     = as.numeric(Deaths),
      Population = as.numeric(Population)
    ) %>%
    filter(YearKey >= 2010, YearKey <= 2025) %>%
    mutate(age_band = ageband_map(age_code)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(age_band)) %>%
    group_by(age_band) %>%
    summarise(
      deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop    = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
      rate   = ifelse(pop > 0, deaths / pop * 100000, NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(col = paste0(prefix_name, "_AAMR_", age_band)) %>%
    select(col, rate) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = rate) %>%
    mutate(YearKey = label) %>%
    select(YearKey, everything())
}

# ============================================================
# 1) Build DEATHS table (2010–2025)
# ============================================================
death_tbl <- full_join(
  deaths_by_year_band(N17_all, "AKI"),
  deaths_by_year_band(A40_all, "Sepsis"),
  by = "YearKey"
) %>%
  full_join(deaths_by_year_band(N17A40_RF, "AKI_Sepsis"), by = "YearKey") %>%
  arrange(YearKey) %>%
  mutate(across(-YearKey, ~ coalesce(.x, 0))) %>%
  select(
    YearKey,
    AKI_deaths_lt20, AKI_deaths_20_44, AKI_deaths_45_64, AKI_deaths_65_plus,
    Sepsis_deaths_lt20, Sepsis_deaths_20_44, Sepsis_deaths_45_64, Sepsis_deaths_65_plus,
    AKI_Sepsis_deaths_lt20, AKI_Sepsis_deaths_20_44, AKI_Sepsis_deaths_45_64, AKI_Sepsis_deaths_65_plus
  )

death_tbl_total <- add_total_row_deaths(death_tbl, label = "2010–2025")

# ============================================================
# 2) Build "AAMR" table (age-band rates per 100,000; 2010–2025)
# ============================================================
aamr_tbl <- full_join(
  rates_by_year_band(N17_all, "AKI"),
  rates_by_year_band(A40_all, "Sepsis"),
  by = "YearKey"
) %>%
  full_join(rates_by_year_band(N17A40_RF, "AKI_Sepsis"), by = "YearKey") %>%
  arrange(YearKey) %>%
  select(
    YearKey,
    AKI_AAMR_lt20, AKI_AAMR_20_44, AKI_AAMR_45_64, AKI_AAMR_65_plus,
    Sepsis_AAMR_lt20, Sepsis_AAMR_20_44, Sepsis_AAMR_45_64, Sepsis_AAMR_65_plus,
    AKI_Sepsis_AAMR_lt20, AKI_Sepsis_AAMR_20_44, AKI_Sepsis_AAMR_45_64, AKI_Sepsis_AAMR_65_plus
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(-YearKey, ~ round(.x, 2)))

aamr_total_row <- full_join(
  rate_total_band(N17_all,    "AKI",       label = "2010–2025"),
  rate_total_band(A40_all,    "Sepsis",    label = "2010–2025"),
  by = "YearKey"
) %>%
  full_join(rate_total_band(N17A40_RF, "AKI_Sepsis", label = "2010–2025"), by = "YearKey") %>%
  select(
    YearKey,
    AKI_AAMR_lt20, AKI_AAMR_20_44, AKI_AAMR_45_64, AKI_AAMR_65_plus,
    Sepsis_AAMR_lt20, Sepsis_AAMR_20_44, Sepsis_AAMR_45_64, Sepsis_AAMR_65_plus,
    AKI_Sepsis_AAMR_lt20, AKI_Sepsis_AAMR_20_44, AKI_Sepsis_AAMR_45_64, AKI_Sepsis_AAMR_65_plus
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(-YearKey, ~ round(.x, 2)))
add_total_row_rates <- function(tbl, total_row) {
  tbl2 <- tbl %>% mutate(YearKey = as.character(YearKey))
  total2 <- total_row %>% mutate(YearKey = as.character(YearKey))
  bind_rows(tbl2, total2)
}
aamr_tbl_total <- add_total_row_rates(aamr_tbl, aamr_total_row)
```

## Sex

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Standardize sex rows from *_all (source == "sex")
# ------------------------------------------------------------
sex_clean <- function(df_all) {

  # find the AAR column name robustly
  aar_col <- intersect(
    names(df_all),
    c("Age Adjusted Rate", "Age adjusted rate", "Age Adjusted Rate ")
  )
  if (length(aar_col) == 0) {
    stop("No 'Age Adjusted Rate' column found in df_all (source=='sex').")
  }
  aar_col <- aar_col[1]

  df_all %>%
    filter(source == "sex") %>%
    transmute(
      YearKey    = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      Sex_chr    = str_trim(as.character(Sex)),
      Code_chr   = str_trim(as.character(`Sex Code`)),
      Notes_chr  = str_trim(as.character(Notes)),
      Deaths     = as.numeric(Deaths),
      Population = as.numeric(Population),
      AAR        = as.numeric(.data[[aar_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(YearKey >= 2010, YearKey <= 2025) %>%
    mutate(
      Sex_std = case_when(
        str_to_lower(Sex_chr) %in% c("female","f") ~ "Female",
        str_to_lower(Sex_chr) %in% c("male","m")   ~ "Male",
        Code_chr == "F" ~ "Female",
        Code_chr == "M" ~ "Male",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      Overall_flag = is.na(Sex_std) & (Notes_chr == "Total" | Sex_chr == "" | is.na(Sex_chr))
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Build yearly deaths (Female/Male/Overall) for one outcome
#    - Overall from Notes=="Total" (preferred) else Female+Male
# ------------------------------------------------------------
sex_deaths_year_one <- function(df_all, prefix_name) {

  base <- sex_clean(df_all)

  # Female/Male
  fm <- base %>%
    filter(Sex_std %in% c("Female","Male")) %>%
    group_by(YearKey, Sex_std) %>%
    summarise(deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Sex_std, values_from = deaths)

  # Overall (prefer Notes=="Total" rows)
  overall <- base %>%
    filter(Overall_flag) %>%
    group_by(YearKey) %>%
    summarise(Overall = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  out <- full_join(fm, overall, by = "YearKey") %>%
    mutate(
      Overall = ifelse(is.na(Overall),
                       coalesce(Female, 0) + coalesce(Male, 0),
                       Overall)
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      YearKey,
      !!paste0(prefix_name, "_deaths_Female")  := coalesce(Female, 0),
      !!paste0(prefix_name, "_deaths_Male")    := coalesce(Male, 0),
      !!paste0(prefix_name, "_deaths_Overall") := coalesce(Overall, 0)
    )

  out
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Total row (2010–2025) for one outcome
# ------------------------------------------------------------
sex_deaths_total_one <- function(df_all, prefix_name, label = "2010–2025") {
  base <- sex_clean(df_all)

  fm <- base %>%
    filter(Sex_std %in% c("Female","Male")) %>%
    group_by(Sex_std) %>%
    summarise(deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Sex_std, values_from = deaths)

  overall <- base %>%
    filter(Overall_flag) %>%
    summarise(Overall = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    as_tibble()

  out <- bind_cols(fm, overall) %>%
    mutate(
      Overall = ifelse(is.na(Overall),
                       coalesce(Female, 0) + coalesce(Male, 0),
                       Overall)
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      YearKey = label,
      !!paste0(prefix_name, "_deaths_Female")  := coalesce(Female, 0),
      !!paste0(prefix_name, "_deaths_Male")    := coalesce(Male, 0),
      !!paste0(prefix_name, "_deaths_Overall") := coalesce(Overall, 0)
    )

  out
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) TABLE 1: Deaths (yearly 2010–2025 + total row)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
sex_deaths_tbl <- full_join(
  sex_deaths_year_one(N17_all, "AKI"),
  sex_deaths_year_one(A40_all, "Sepsis"),
  by = "YearKey"
) %>%
  full_join(sex_deaths_year_one(N17A40_RF, "AKI_Sepsis"), by = "YearKey") %>%
  arrange(YearKey)

sex_deaths_total <- bind_cols(
  sex_deaths_total_one(N17_all, "AKI"),
  sex_deaths_total_one(A40_all, "Sepsis") %>% select(-YearKey),
  sex_deaths_total_one(N17A40_RF, "AKI_Sepsis") %>% select(-YearKey)
)

sex_deaths_tbl_total <- bind_rows(
  sex_deaths_tbl %>% mutate(YearKey = as.character(YearKey)),
  sex_deaths_total
) %>%
  select(
    YearKey,
    AKI_deaths_Female, AKI_deaths_Male, AKI_deaths_Overall,
    Sepsis_deaths_Female, Sepsis_deaths_Male, Sepsis_deaths_Overall,
    AKI_Sepsis_deaths_Female, AKI_Sepsis_deaths_Male, AKI_Sepsis_deaths_Overall
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5) TABLE 2: Sex-specific crude rates (/100,000) + overall crude rate
#     - Female/Male: sum(D)/sum(P)*100k
#     - Overall: from Notes=="Total" rows if available, else (Female+Male)/(FemalePop+MalePop)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# AAMR by sex (yearly 2010–2025)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# yearly AAMR table
sex_aamr_year_one <- function(df_all, prefix_name) {

  base <- sex_clean(df_all)

  fm <- base %>%
    filter(Sex_std %in% c("Female","Male")) %>%
    group_by(YearKey, Sex_std) %>%
    summarise(
      AAMR = ifelse(sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                    sum(AAR * Population, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
                    NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Sex_std, values_from = AAMR)

  overall <- base %>%
    filter(Overall_flag) %>%
    group_by(YearKey) %>%
    summarise(
      AAMR = ifelse(sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                    sum(AAR * Population, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
                    NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  full_join(fm, overall, by = "YearKey") %>%
    transmute(
      YearKey,
      !!paste0(prefix_name, "_AAMR_Female")  := round(Female, 2),
      !!paste0(prefix_name, "_AAMR_Male")    := round(Male, 2),
      !!paste0(prefix_name, "_AAMR_Overall") := round(AAMR, 2)
    )
}

# total row AAMR (2010–2025)
sex_aamr_total_one <- function(df_all, prefix_name, label = "2010–2025") {

  base <- sex_clean(df_all)

  fm <- base %>%
    filter(Sex_std %in% c("Female","Male")) %>%
    group_by(Sex_std) %>%
    summarise(
      AAMR = ifelse(sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                    sum(AAR * Population, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
                    NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Sex_std, values_from = AAMR)

  overall <- base %>%
    filter(Overall_flag) %>%
    summarise(
      AAMR = ifelse(sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                    sum(AAR * Population, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
                    NA_real_)
    )

  bind_cols(fm, overall) %>%
    transmute(
      YearKey = label,
      !!paste0(prefix_name, "_AAMR_Female")  := round(Female, 2),
      !!paste0(prefix_name, "_AAMR_Male")    := round(Male, 2),
      !!paste0(prefix_name, "_AAMR_Overall") := round(AAMR, 2)
    )
}

# Build full table across outcomes
sex_aamr_tbl <- full_join(
  sex_aamr_year_one(N17_all, "AKI"),
  sex_aamr_year_one(A40_all, "Sepsis"),
  by = "YearKey"
) %>%
  full_join(sex_aamr_year_one(N17A40_RF, "AKI_Sepsis"), by = "YearKey") %>%
  arrange(YearKey)

sex_aamr_total <- bind_cols(
  sex_aamr_total_one(N17_all, "AKI"),
  sex_aamr_total_one(A40_all, "Sepsis") %>% select(-YearKey),
  sex_aamr_total_one(N17A40_RF, "AKI_Sepsis") %>% select(-YearKey)
)

sex_aamr_tbl_total <- bind_rows(
  sex_aamr_tbl %>% mutate(YearKey = as.character(YearKey)),
  sex_aamr_total
) %>%
  select(
    YearKey,
    AKI_AAMR_Female, AKI_AAMR_Male, AKI_AAMR_Overall,
    Sepsis_AAMR_Female, Sepsis_AAMR_Male, Sepsis_AAMR_Overall,
    AKI_Sepsis_AAMR_Female, AKI_Sepsis_AAMR_Male, AKI_Sepsis_AAMR_Overall
  )

sex_aamr_tbl_total
```

## Portional
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
})

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Overall AAMR (all ages) by YearKey from sex TOTAL rows
#    (population-weighted mean of WONDER "Age Adjusted Rate")
# ------------------------------------------------------------
overall_aamr_by_year <- function(df_all, out_label) {

  # robust AAR column find
  aar_col <- intersect(names(df_all), c("Age Adjusted Rate", "Age adjusted rate", "Age Adjusted Rate "))
  if (length(aar_col) == 0) stop("No 'Age Adjusted Rate' column found.")
  aar_col <- aar_col[1]

  df_all %>%
    filter(source == "sex") %>%
    transmute(
      YearKey    = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      Notes_chr  = str_trim(as.character(Notes)),
      Sex_chr    = str_trim(as.character(Sex)),
      Deaths     = as.numeric(Deaths),
      Population = as.numeric(Population),
      AAR        = as.numeric(.data[[aar_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(YearKey >= 2010, YearKey <= 2025) %>%
    # keep overall rows: prefer Notes=="Total"; otherwise blank Sex
    mutate(overall_flag = (Notes_chr == "Total") | (is.na(Sex_chr) | Sex_chr == "")) %>%
    filter(overall_flag) %>%
    group_by(YearKey) %>%
    summarise(
      AAMR = ifelse(sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                   sum(AAR * Population, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
                   NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(outcome = out_label)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Build the ratio table
#    Sepsis among AKI = (AKI&Sepsis) / (AKI)
#    AKI among Sepsis = (AKI&Sepsis) / (Sepsis)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
ratio_tbl <- full_join(
  overall_aamr_by_year(N17_all,    "AKI"),
  overall_aamr_by_year(A40_all,    "Sepsis"),
  by = "YearKey",
  suffix = c("_AKI", "_Sepsis")
) %>%
  full_join(
    overall_aamr_by_year(N17A40_RF, "AKI / Sepsis"),
    by = "YearKey"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    YearKey = YearKey,

    `AKI (AAMR all ages)` = round(AAMR_AKI, 2),
    `Sepsis (AAMR all ages)` = round(AAMR_Sepsis, 2),
    `AKI / Sepsis (AAMR all ages)` = round(AAMR, 2),

    `Sepsis among AKI ((3)/(1))` =
      round((AAMR) / (AAMR_AKI), 4),

    `AKI among Sepsis ((3)/(2))` =
      round((AAMR) / (AAMR_Sepsis), 4)
  ) %>%
  arrange(YearKey)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Add total row (2010–2025) based on population-weighted AAMR totals
#    and compute ratios from those totals
# ------------------------------------------------------------
overall_aamr_total <- function(df_all, out_label, label = "2010–2025") {

  aar_col <- intersect(names(df_all), c("Age Adjusted Rate", "Age adjusted rate", "Age Adjusted Rate "))
  if (length(aar_col) == 0) stop("No 'Age Adjusted Rate' column found.")
  aar_col <- aar_col[1]

  df_all %>%
    filter(source == "sex") %>%
    transmute(
      YearKey    = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      Notes_chr  = str_trim(as.character(Notes)),
      Sex_chr    = str_trim(as.character(Sex)),
      Population = as.numeric(Population),
      AAR        = as.numeric(.data[[aar_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(YearKey >= 2010, YearKey <= 2025) %>%
    mutate(overall_flag = (Notes_chr == "Total") | (is.na(Sex_chr) | Sex_chr == "")) %>%
    filter(overall_flag) %>%
    summarise(
      AAMR = ifelse(sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                   sum(AAR * Population, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
                   NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    transmute(YearKey = label, outcome = out_label, AAMR = AAMR)
}

tot_AKI    <- overall_aamr_total(N17_all,    "AKI")
tot_Sepsis <- overall_aamr_total(A40_all,    "Sepsis")
tot_Both   <- overall_aamr_total(N17A40_RF, "AKI / Sepsis")

total_row <- tibble(
  YearKey = "2010–2025",
  `AKI (AAMR all ages)` = round(tot_AKI$AAMR, 2),
  `Sepsis (AAMR all ages)` = round(tot_Sepsis$AAMR, 2),
  `AKI / Sepsis (AAMR all ages)` = round(tot_Both$AAMR, 2),
  `Sepsis among AKI ((3)/(1))` = round(tot_Both$AAMR / tot_AKI$AAMR, 4),
  `AKI among Sepsis ((3)/(2))` = round(tot_Both$AAMR / tot_Sepsis$AAMR, 4)
)

ratio_tbl_total <- bind_rows(
  ratio_tbl %>% mutate(YearKey = as.character(YearKey)),
  total_row
)

ratio_tbl_total
```
## Overall

```{r}
# ============================================================
# ONE summary table (2010–2025) with columns: AKI / Sepsis / AKI & sepsis
# Rows = Metric (as you specified), including Age, Race, Place of death blocks
#
# Assumes you already have:
#   N17_all, A40_all, N17A40_all
#   pod_wide (period × dataset × Avg annual deaths (Medical/Non-medical))
#   recode_to_std_age(), ageband_map() (or we define here)
#
# Uses:
# - Deaths/pop/crude from sex TOTAL rows (Notes=="Total" preferred)
# - AAMR all-ages + Male/Female AAMR from WONDER Age Adjusted Rate (sex table), pop-weighted
# - Age-band rates (<20, 20–44, 45–64, ≥65) = sum(D)/sum(P)*100k from age table
# - Race AAMR = pop-weighted mean of WONDER Age Adjusted Rate (race table)
# - Place of death = from pod_wide avg annual deaths, expressed as N (%)
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
})

# ----------------------------
# helpers
# ----------------------------
fmt_int <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, formatC(round(x), format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ","))
fmt_rate2 <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_, formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ","))
fmt_n_pct <- function(n, denom, digits = 1) {
  ifelse(is.na(n) | is.na(denom) | denom == 0,
         NA_character_,
         paste0(fmt_int(n), " (", formatC(100 * n/denom, format = "f", digits = digits), "%)"))
}

ageband_map <- function(age_code) {
  case_when(
    age_code %in% c("1","1-4","5-9","10-14","15-19") ~ "<20",
    age_code %in% c("20-24","25-29","30-34","35-39","40-44") ~ "20–44",
    age_code %in% c("45-49","50-54","55-59","60-64") ~ "45–64",
    age_code %in% c("65-69","70-74","75-79","80-84","85+") ~ "≥65",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

get_aar_col <- function(df) {
  aar_col <- intersect(names(df), c("Age Adjusted Rate", "Age adjusted rate", "Age Adjusted Rate "))
  if (length(aar_col) == 0) stop("No 'Age Adjusted Rate' column found in this dataset.")
  aar_col[1]
}

# ----------------------------
# 1) Overall totals from SEX table (2010–2025)
# ----------------------------
overall_totals_2010_2025 <- function(df_all) {
  aar_col <- get_aar_col(df_all)

  # choose ONE "overall" row per year (prefer Notes=="Total")
  yearly_overall <- df_all %>%
    filter(source == "sex") %>%
    transmute(
      YearKey    = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      Notes_chr  = str_trim(as.character(Notes)),
      Sex_chr    = str_trim(as.character(Sex)),
      Deaths     = as.numeric(Deaths),
      Population = as.numeric(Population),
      AAR        = as.numeric(.data[[aar_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(YearKey >= 2010, YearKey <= 2025) %>%
    mutate(
      overall_flag = (Notes_chr == "Total") | (is.na(Sex_chr) | Sex_chr == ""),
      overall_rank = ifelse(Notes_chr == "Total", 1L, 2L)
    ) %>%
    filter(overall_flag) %>%
    arrange(YearKey, overall_rank) %>%
    group_by(YearKey) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()

  yearly_overall %>%
    summarise(
      total_deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_pop    = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
      crude_rate   = ifelse(sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                            sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE)/sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE)*100000,
                            NA_real_),
      AAMR_all     = ifelse(sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                            sum(AAR * Population, na.rm = TRUE)/sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
                            NA_real_)
    )
}

# ----------------------------
# 2) Sex-specific deaths and AAMR (2010–2025)
# ----------------------------
sex_stats_2010_2025 <- function(df_all) {
  aar_col <- get_aar_col(df_all)

  base <- df_all %>%
    filter(source == "sex") %>%
    transmute(
      YearKey    = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      Sex_chr    = str_trim(as.character(Sex)),
      Code_chr   = str_trim(as.character(`Sex Code`)),
      Deaths     = as.numeric(Deaths),
      Population = as.numeric(Population),
      AAR        = as.numeric(.data[[aar_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(YearKey >= 2010, YearKey <= 2025) %>%
    mutate(
      Sex_std = case_when(
        str_to_lower(Sex_chr) %in% c("female","f") ~ "Female",
        str_to_lower(Sex_chr) %in% c("male","m")   ~ "Male",
        Code_chr == "F" ~ "Female",
        Code_chr == "M" ~ "Male",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(Sex_std %in% c("Female","Male"))

  out <- base %>%
    group_by(Sex_std) %>%
    summarise(
      deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      AAMR   = ifelse(sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                      sum(AAR * Population, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
                      NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  tibble(
    Male_deaths   = out$deaths[out$Sex_std == "Male"]   %>% dplyr::coalesce(0),
    Female_deaths = out$deaths[out$Sex_std == "Female"] %>% dplyr::coalesce(0),
    Male_AAMR     = out$AAMR[out$Sex_std == "Male"]     %>% dplyr::coalesce(NA_real_),
    Female_AAMR   = out$AAMR[out$Sex_std == "Female"]   %>% dplyr::coalesce(NA_real_)
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# 3) Age-band rates (<20, 20–44, 45–64, ≥65) from AGE table (2010–2025)
#     = sum(D)/sum(P)*100k within each band
# ----------------------------
age_band_rates_2010_2025 <- function(df_all) {

  df_all %>%
    filter(source == "age") %>%
    transmute(
      YearKey    = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      age_code   = recode_to_std_age(`Five-Year Age Groups Code`),
      Deaths     = as.numeric(Deaths),
      Population = as.numeric(Population)
    ) %>%
    filter(YearKey >= 2010, YearKey <= 2025) %>%
    mutate(age_band = ageband_map(age_code)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(age_band)) %>%
    group_by(age_band) %>%
    summarise(
      deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
      pop    = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
      rate   = ifelse(pop > 0, deaths/pop*100000, NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      Metric = paste0("Age ", age_band, " AAMR, /100,000"),
      value  = rate
    )
}

# ----------------------------
# 4) Race AAMR (2010–2025) from RACE table (pop-weighted AAR)
# ----------------------------
race_aamr_2010_2025 <- function(df_all) {
  aar_col <- get_aar_col(df_all)

  keep <- c(
    "American Indian or Alaska Native",
    "Asian",
    "Black or African American",
    "Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander",
    "White",
    "More than one race"
  )

  df_all %>%
    filter(source == "race", !is.na(race)) %>%
    transmute(
      YearKey    = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      race       = as.character(race),
      Population = as.numeric(Population),
      AAR        = as.numeric(.data[[aar_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(YearKey >= 2010, YearKey <= 2025, race %in% keep) %>%
    group_by(race) %>%
    summarise(
      AAMR = ifelse(sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                   sum(AAR * Population, na.rm = TRUE)/sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
                   NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      Metric = paste0(race, " AAMR, /100,000"),
      value  = AAMR
    )
}

# ----------------------------
# 5) Place of death N(%) from pod_wide (Avg annual deaths)
#     NOTE: uses avg annual deaths within each period; we aggregate across periods
#     by summing avg annual deaths across periods equally weighted.
#     If you prefer TRUE totals (not avg annual), swap to your underlying totals.
# ----------------------------
pod_n_pct_2010_2025 <- function(pod_wide, dataset_label) {

  x <- pod_wide %>%
    filter(dataset == dataset_label) %>%
    summarise(
      med = sum(`Avg annual deaths (Medical Facility)`, na.rm = TRUE),
      non = sum(`Avg annual deaths (Non-medical facility)`, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  total <- x$med + x$non

  tibble(
    Metric = c("Medical Facility, n (%)", "Non-medical facility, n (%)"),
    value  = c(
      fmt_n_pct(x$med, total, digits = 1),
      fmt_n_pct(x$non, total, digits = 1)
    )
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# 6) Build ONE column of metrics for one outcome
# ----------------------------
build_one_outcome_col <- function(df_all, outcome_name, pod_dataset_name = NULL, pod_wide = NULL) {

  overall <- overall_totals_2010_2025(df_all)
  sex     <- sex_stats_2010_2025(df_all)

  base_rows <- {
  overall <- overall_totals_2010_2025(df_all)
  sex     <- sex_stats_2010_2025(df_all)

  tibble(
    Metric = c(
      "Total deaths (standardizable ages), n",
      "Male deaths, n (%)",
      "Female deaths, n (%)",
      "Total population (standardizable ages)",
      "Crude mortality rate (standardizable ages), /100,000",
      "AAMR (all ages), /100,000",
      "Male AAMR (all ages), /100,000",
      "Female AAMR (all ages), /100,000"
    ),
    value = c(
      fmt_int(overall$total_deaths),
      fmt_n_pct(sex$Male_deaths,   overall$total_deaths, digits = 1),
      fmt_n_pct(sex$Female_deaths, overall$total_deaths, digits = 1),
      fmt_int(overall$total_pop),
      fmt_rate2(overall$crude_rate),
      fmt_rate2(overall$AAMR_all),
      fmt_rate2(sex$Male_AAMR),
      fmt_rate2(sex$Female_AAMR)
    )
  )
}

  age_header  <- tibble(Metric = "Age categories", value = NA_character_)
  race_header <- tibble(Metric = "Race and ethnicity", value = NA_character_)
  pod_header  <- tibble(Metric = "Place of death", value = NA_character_)

  age_rows <- age_band_rates_2010_2025(df_all) %>%
    mutate(value = fmt_rate2(value)) %>%
    mutate(Metric = paste0("  ", Metric)) %>%
    transmute(Metric, value)

  race_rows <- race_aamr_2010_2025(df_all) %>%
    mutate(value = fmt_rate2(value)) %>%
    mutate(Metric = paste0("  ", Metric)) %>%
    transmute(Metric, value)

  pod_rows <- tibble(Metric = character(), value = character())
  if (!is.null(pod_wide) && !is.null(pod_dataset_name)) {
    pod_rows <- pod_n_pct_2010_2025(pod_wide, pod_dataset_name) %>%
      mutate(Metric = paste0("  ", Metric)) %>%
      transmute(Metric, value)
  }

  bind_rows(
    base_rows,
    age_header,
    age_rows,
    race_header,
    race_rows,
    pod_header,
    pod_rows
  ) %>%
    rename(!!outcome_name := value)
}

# ============================================================
# FINAL TABLE
# ============================================================
tbl_AKI <- build_one_outcome_col(N17_all,    "AKI",         pod_dataset_name = "AKI",          pod_wide = pod_wide)
tbl_SEP <- build_one_outcome_col(A40_all,    "Sepsis",      pod_dataset_name = "Sepsis",       pod_wide = pod_wide)
tbl_BTH <- build_one_outcome_col(N17A40_RF, "AKI & sepsis",pod_dataset_name = "AKI & Sepsis", pod_wide = pod_wide)

table_S <- tbl_AKI %>%
  left_join(tbl_SEP, by = "Metric") %>%
  left_join(tbl_BTH, by = "Metric") %>%
  select(Metric, AKI, Sepsis, `AKI & sepsis`)

table_S
```

```{r}
library(officer)
library(flextable)

# ---- flextable helper (robust across versions) ----
df_to_flex <- function(df, font_size = 10) {
  flextable(df) |>
    theme_booktabs() |>
    fontsize(size = font_size, part = "all") |>
    autofit() |>
    set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")
}

# Optional: auto-shrink very wide tables a bit
pick_font <- function(df) {
  p <- ncol(df)
  if (p >= 12) 8 else if (p >= 9) 9 else 10
}

add_table_section <- function(doc, title, df) {
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, title, style = "heading 1")
  doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, df_to_flex(df, font_size = pick_font(df)))
  doc <- body_add_par(doc, "", style = "Normal") # spacer
  doc
}
```

## Trend
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Publication-style trend plot
# - Custom age-group colors
# - Light grey: 2020–2022 (Pandemic)
# - Darker grey: 2023 (Transition)
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# -----------------------------
# 1) Prepare long plotting data
# -----------------------------
plot_df <- aamr_tbl %>%
  filter(YearKey >= 2010, YearKey <= 2025) %>%
  select(
    YearKey,
    AKI_AAMR_20_44, AKI_AAMR_45_64, AKI_AAMR_65_plus,
    Sepsis_AAMR_20_44, Sepsis_AAMR_45_64, Sepsis_AAMR_65_plus,
    AKI_Sepsis_AAMR_20_44, AKI_Sepsis_AAMR_45_64, AKI_Sepsis_AAMR_65_plus
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -YearKey,
    names_to = "key",
    values_to = "AAMR"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(
      str_starts(key, "AKI_Sepsis") ~ "AKI/sepsis",
      str_starts(key, "AKI_")       ~ "AKI",
      str_starts(key, "Sepsis_")    ~ "Sepsis",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    age_group = case_when(
      str_detect(key, "_20_44$")   ~ "20–44",
      str_detect(key, "_45_64$")   ~ "45–64",
      str_detect(key, "_65_plus$") ~ "65+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    outcome   = factor(outcome, levels = c("AKI", "AKI/sepsis", "Sepsis")),
    age_group = factor(age_group, levels = c("20–44", "45–64", "65+"))
  )

# -----------------------------
# 2) Define shaded periods
# -----------------------------
pandemic_band <- tibble(
  xmin = 2020,
  xmax = 2023,   # 2020–2022 (xmax exclusive visually)
  ymin = -Inf,
  ymax = Inf
)

transition_band <- tibble(
  xmin = 2023,
  xmax = 2024,   # 2023 only
  ymin = -Inf,
  ymax = Inf
)

# -----------------------------
# 3) Plot
# -----------------------------
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = YearKey, y = AAMR,
                         group = age_group, color = age_group)) +

  # Light grey pandemic shading
  geom_rect(
    data = pandemic_band,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey85",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  # Darker transition shading
  geom_rect(
    data = transition_band,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey70",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  # Trend lines
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6) +

  facet_wrap(~ outcome, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "20–44" = "#1b9e77",
    "45–64" = "#d95f02",
    "65+"   = "#7570b3"
  )) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(2010, 2025, by = 3),
    limits = c(2010, 2025)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "AAMR (per 100,000)",
    color = "Age group",
    caption = "Grey shading denotes the COVID-19 pandemic period (2020–2022); darker shading denotes the transition year (2023)."
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text  = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Export 3 individual panels (AKI, AKI/sepsis, Sepsis) as 300-dpi TIFF
# Saves to: Figures/  (creates folder if missing)
# Assumes you already created `plot_df` and the two shading tibbles
# (pandemic_band, transition_band) from the previous code.
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# --- ensure output dir exists
dir.create("Figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# --- color map
age_cols <- c(
  "20–44" = "#1b9e77",
  "45–64" = "#d95f02",
  "65+"   = "#7570b3"
)

# --- base plot builder for one outcome
make_outcome_plot <- function(outcome_name) {

  df1 <- plot_df %>% filter(outcome == outcome_name)

  ggplot(df1, aes(x = YearKey, y = AAMR, group = age_group, color = age_group)) +

    # Light grey pandemic shading (2020–2022)
    geom_rect(
      data = pandemic_band,
      aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = "grey85",
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +

    # Darker transition shading (2023)
    geom_rect(
      data = transition_band,
      aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = "grey70",
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +

    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 2.6) +

    scale_color_manual(values = age_cols) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(2010, 2025, by = 3),
      limits = c(2010, 2025)
    ) +

    labs(
      title = outcome_name,
      x = "Year",
      y = "AAMR (per 100,000)",
      color = "Age group",
      caption = "Grey shading denotes the COVID-19 pandemic period (2020–2022); darker shading denotes the transition year (2023)."
    ) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text  = element_text(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

# --- build each plot
p_aki       <- make_outcome_plot("AKI")
p_akisepsis <- make_outcome_plot("AKI/sepsis")
p_sepsis    <- make_outcome_plot("Sepsis")

# --- export settings (TIFF, 300 dpi)
# Choose size: adjust width/height if your journal wants different dimensions
export_tiff_300 <- function(p, filename, width_in = 9.0, height_in = 6.0) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("Figures", filename),
    plot = p,
    device = "tiff",
    dpi = 300,
    width = width_in,
    height = height_in,
    units = "in",
    compression = "lzw"
  )
}

export_tiff_300(p_aki,       "figure/Fig_AKI_AAMR_trend_300dpi.tiff")
export_tiff_300(p_akisepsis, "figure/Fig_AKI_sepsis_AAMR_trend_300dpi.tiff")
export_tiff_300(p_sepsis,    "figure/Fig_Sepsis_AAMR_trend_300dpi.tiff")

# If you also want a combined 3-panel export as TIFF:
export_tiff_300(p, "figure/Fig_All3_AAMR_trend_300dpi.tiff", width_in = 12, height_in = 4.8)
```

## Sex trend

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Sex-specific AAMR trend plot (like your example) + exports
# - 3 facets: AKI / AKI/sepsis / Sepsis
# - lines+points for Sex: Male, Female
# - Grey shading: 2020–2022; darker shading: 2023
# - Export 3 individual 300-dpi TIFFs to Figures/
#
# Assumes you have: N17_all, A40_all, N17A40_all
# and that each has source=="sex" rows with columns:
#   Year Code, Sex, Sex Code, Notes, Population, Age Adjusted Rate
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

dir.create("Figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# -----------------------------
# 0) helpers
# -----------------------------
get_aar_col <- function(df) {
  aar_col <- intersect(names(df), c("Age Adjusted Rate", "Age adjusted rate", "Age Adjusted Rate "))
  if (length(aar_col) == 0) stop("No 'Age Adjusted Rate' column found.")
  aar_col[1]
}

sex_long_one <- function(df_all, outcome_label) {
  aar_col <- get_aar_col(df_all)

  df_all %>%
    filter(source == "sex") %>%
    transmute(
      Year = as.integer(`Year Code`),
      Sex_chr  = str_trim(as.character(Sex)),
      Code_chr = str_trim(as.character(`Sex Code`)),
      Notes_chr= str_trim(as.character(Notes)),
      Population = as.numeric(Population),
      AAR = as.numeric(.data[[aar_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(Year >= 2010, Year <= 2025) %>%
    mutate(
      Sex_std = case_when(
        str_to_lower(Sex_chr) %in% c("male","m") ~ "Male",
        str_to_lower(Sex_chr) %in% c("female","f") ~ "Female",
        Code_chr == "M" ~ "Male",
        Code_chr == "F" ~ "Female",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(Sex_std %in% c("Male", "Female")) %>%
    group_by(Year, Sex_std) %>%
    summarise(
      AAMR = ifelse(sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
                   sum(AAR * Population, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
                   NA_real_),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      outcome = outcome_label,
      Sex_std = factor(Sex_std, levels = c("Male", "Female"))
    )
}

# -----------------------------
# 1) Build plotting data (long)
# -----------------------------
sex_plot_df <- bind_rows(
  sex_long_one(N17_all,    "AKI"),
  sex_long_one(N17A40_all, "AKI/sepsis"),
  sex_long_one(A40_all,    "Sepsis")
) %>%
  mutate(outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("AKI", "AKI/sepsis", "Sepsis")))

# -----------------------------
# 2) Shading bands
# -----------------------------
pandemic_band <- tibble(xmin = 2020, xmax = 2023, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)  # 2020–2022
transition_band <- tibble(xmin = 2023, xmax = 2024, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf) # 2023

# -----------------------------
# 3) Plot function (single panel)
# -----------------------------
sex_cols <- c("Male" = "#1f78b4", "Female" = "#d95f02")  # matches your screenshot style

make_sex_outcome_plot <- function(outcome_name) {

  df1 <- sex_plot_df %>% filter(outcome == outcome_name)

  ggplot(df1, aes(x = Year, y = AAMR, group = Sex_std, color = Sex_std)) +

    geom_rect(
      data = pandemic_band,
      aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = "grey85",
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_rect(
      data = transition_band,
      aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = "grey70",
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +

    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 2.6) +

    scale_color_manual(values = sex_cols) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(2010, 2025, by = 3),
      limits = c(2010, 2025)
    ) +

    labs(
      title = outcome_name,
      x = "Year",
      y = "AAMR(per 100,000)",
      color = "Sex",
      caption = "Grey shading denotes the COVID-19 pandemic period (2020–2022); darker shading denotes the transition year (2023)."
    ) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text  = element_text(color = "black"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

# -----------------------------
# 4) Create plots
# -----------------------------
p_sex_aki       <- make_sex_outcome_plot("AKI")
p_sex_akisepsis <- make_sex_outcome_plot("AKI/sepsis")
p_sex_sepsis    <- make_sex_outcome_plot("Sepsis")

p_sex_aki
p_sex_akisepsis
p_sex_sepsis

# -----------------------------
# 5) Export 300-dpi TIFFs
# -----------------------------
export_tiff_300 <- function(p, filename, width_in = 9.0, height_in = 6.0) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("Figures", filename),
    plot = p,
    device = "tiff",
    dpi = 300,
    width = width_in,
    height = height_in,
    units = "in",
    compression = "lzw"
  )
}

export_tiff_300(p_sex_aki,       "Fig_AKI_AAMR_sex_300dpi.tiff")
export_tiff_300(p_sex_akisepsis, "Fig_AKI_sepsis_AAMR_sex_300dpi.tiff")
export_tiff_300(p_sex_sepsis,    "Fig_Sepsis_AAMR_sex_300dpi.tiff")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
```
```{r}
# Sepsis (<20) trend graph (AAMR per 100,000) + 300-dpi TIFF export
# Uses AGE table (source == "age") and computes band rate:
#   sum(deaths)/sum(pop) * 100,000 for ages <20
# Grey shading: 2020–2022; darker: 2023
#
# Assumes you already have:
#   A40_all
#   recode_to_std_age()
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tibble)
})

dir.create("Figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- age codes for <20 (after recode_to_std_age)
ages_lt20 <- c("1","1-4","5-9","10-14","15-19")

# ---- build yearly <20 rate table for Sepsis
sepsis_lt20_df <- A40_all %>%
  filter(source == "age") %>%
  transmute(
    Year = as.integer(`Year Code`),
    age_code = recode_to_std_age(`Five-Year Age Groups Code`),
    Deaths = as.numeric(Deaths),
    Population = as.numeric(Population)
  ) %>%
  filter(Year >= 2010, Year <= 2025, age_code %in% ages_lt20) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    deaths_lt20 = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
    pop_lt20    = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
    AAMR_lt20   = ifelse(pop_lt20 > 0, deaths_lt20 / pop_lt20 * 100000, NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---- shading bands
pandemic_band   <- tibble(xmin = 2020, xmax = 2023, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)
transition_band <- tibble(xmin = 2023, xmax = 2024, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)

# ---- plot
p_sepsis_lt20 <- ggplot(sepsis_lt20_df, aes(x = Year, y = AAMR_lt20)) +

  geom_rect(
    data = pandemic_band,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey85",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = transition_band,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey70",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2, color = "#D55E00") +
  geom_point(size = 2.6, color = "#D55E00") +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(2010, 2025, by = 3),
    limits = c(2010, 2025)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Sepsis (<20)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "AAMR (per 100,000)",
    caption = "Grey shading denotes the COVID-19 pandemic period (2020–2022); darker shading denotes the transition year (2023)."
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text  = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_sepsis_lt20

# ---- export 300-dpi TIFF
ggsave(
  filename = "Figures/Fig_Sepsis_AAMR_lt20_300dpi.tiff",
  plot = p_sepsis_lt20,
  device = "tiff",
  dpi = 300,
  width = 9,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",

)
```

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({

get_year_col <- function(df) {
  yc <- intersect(names(df), c("YearKey", "Year", "Year Code", "year"))
  if (length(yc) == 0) stop("No year column found in: ", paste(names(df), collapse = ", "))
  yc[1]
}

to_plot_tbl <- function(df, disease_label) {
  ycol <- get_year_col(df)
  df %>%
    transmute(
      YearKey = as.integer(.data[[ycol]]),
      AAMR    = as.numeric(`AAMR (/100,000), age-adjusted (all ages)`),
      Disease = disease_label
    ) %>%
    filter(YearKey >= 2010, YearKey <= 2025)
}

  to_plot_tbl(tbl_A40,    "Sepsis")
) %>%
  mutate(Disease = factor(Disease, levels = c("AKI", "AKI/sepsis", "Sepsis")))
```

## APC
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
})

# ---- helper: year-to-year APC (percent change) ----
calc_yoy_apc <- function(rate, prev_rate) {
  # APC only defined if both years exist and prev_rate > 0
  ifelse(is.na(rate) | is.na(prev_rate) | prev_rate <= 0, NA_real_,
         100 * (rate / prev_rate - 1))
}

# ---- 1) Wide -> Long, parse Disease + Age group ----
aamr_long <- aamr_tbl %>%
  mutate(YearKey = as.integer(YearKey)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -YearKey,
    names_to = "series",
    values_to = "AAMR"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Disease = case_when(
      str_starts(series, "AKI_Sepsis_") ~ "AKI/Sepsis",
      str_starts(series, "AKI_")        ~ "AKI",
      str_starts(series, "Sepsis_")     ~ "Sepsis",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    AgeGroup = case_when(
      str_ends(series, "_lt20")    ~ "<20",
      str_ends(series, "_20_44")   ~ "20–44",
      str_ends(series, "_45_64")   ~ "45–64",
      str_ends(series, "_65_plus") ~ "65+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Disease), !is.na(AgeGroup)) %>%
  arrange(Disease, AgeGroup, YearKey)

# ---- 2) Compute year-to-year APC within each Disease x AgeGroup ----
apc_long <- aamr_long %>%
  group_by(Disease, AgeGroup) %>%
  mutate(
    prev_AAMR = lag(AAMR),
    APC_yoy   = calc_yoy_apc(AAMR, prev_AAMR)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Result: long table
apc_long %>%
  select(YearKey, Disease, AgeGroup, AAMR, prev_AAMR, APC_yoy) %>%
  arrange(Disease, AgeGroup, YearKey)
```
```{r}
apc_wide <- apc_long %>%
  mutate(
    apc_col = case_when(
      Disease == "AKI"        ~ paste0("AKI_APC_", AgeGroup),
      Disease == "Sepsis"     ~ paste0("Sepsis_APC_", AgeGroup),
      Disease == "AKI/Sepsis" ~ paste0("AKI_Sepsis_APC_", AgeGroup),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    apc_col = apc_col %>%
      str_replace_all("20–44", "20_44") %>%
      str_replace_all("45–64", "45_64") %>%
      str_replace_all("<20", "lt20") %>%
      str_replace_all("65\\+", "65_plus"),
    APC_yoy = round(APC_yoy, 2)   # <-- round here
  ) %>%
  select(YearKey, apc_col, APC_yoy) %>%
  filter(!is.na(apc_col)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = apc_col, values_from = APC_yoy) %>%
  arrange(YearKey)

apc_wide
```

## APC plot
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tibble)
})

dir.create("Figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# -----------------------------
# 1) Wide -> long, parse disease + age group
# -----------------------------
aamr_long <- aamr_tbl %>%
  mutate(YearKey = as.integer(YearKey)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -YearKey,
    names_to = "series",
    values_to = "AAMR"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Disease = case_when(
      str_starts(series, "AKI_Sepsis_") ~ "AKI/sepsis",
      str_starts(series, "AKI_")        ~ "AKI",
      str_starts(series, "Sepsis_")     ~ "Sepsis",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    AgeGroup = case_when(
      str_ends(series, "_lt20")    ~ "<20",
      str_ends(series, "_20_44")   ~ "20–44",
      str_ends(series, "_45_64")   ~ "45–64",
      str_ends(series, "_65_plus") ~ "65+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Disease), !is.na(AgeGroup)) %>%
  arrange(Disease, AgeGroup, YearKey)

# -----------------------------
# 2) Year-to-year APC (%)
# APC_t = 100 * (AAMR_t / AAMR_{t-1} - 1)
# -----------------------------
apc_long <- aamr_long %>%
  group_by(Disease, AgeGroup) %>%
  mutate(
    prev_AAMR = lag(AAMR),
    APC = ifelse(is.na(AAMR) | is.na(prev_AAMR) | prev_AAMR <= 0,
                 NA_real_,
                 100 * (AAMR / prev_AAMR - 1))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Keep only the age groups shown in your figure
plot_df <- apc_long %>%
  filter(AgeGroup %in% c("20–44", "45–64", "65+")) %>%
  mutate(
    Disease  = factor(Disease, levels = c("AKI", "AKI/sepsis", "Sepsis")),
    AgeGroup = factor(AgeGroup, levels = c("20–44", "45–64", "65+"))
  )

# -----------------------------
# 3) Shading bands (same as your figure)
# light grey: 2020–2022  => [2020, 2023)
# darker grey: 2023      => [2023, 2024)
# -----------------------------
band_light <- tibble(xmin = 2020, xmax = 2023, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)
band_dark  <- tibble(xmin = 2023, xmax = 2024, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)

# Age group colors (match screenshot vibe)
age_cols <- c(
  "20–44" = "#1B9E77",  # green
  "45–64" = "#D95F02",  # orange
  "65+"   = "#7570B3"   # purple
)

# -----------------------------
# 4) Plot
# -----------------------------
p_apc <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = YearKey, y = APC, color = AgeGroup, group = AgeGroup)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = band_light,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey90",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = band_dark,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey80",
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey55") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Disease, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = age_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(2010, 2025),
    breaks = seq(2010, 2025, by = 3)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Annual percent change (APC, %)",
    color = "Age group",
    caption = "Light grey: COVID-19 pandemic (2020–2022); darker grey: transition year (2023)."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 16),

    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),

    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.text  = element_text(color = "grey30", size = 14),

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

p_apc

# -----------------------------
# 5) Export 300-dpi TIFF
# -----------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = "Figures/Fig_APC_yoy_3diseases_agegroups_300dpi.tiff",
  plot = p_apc,
  device = "tiff",
  dpi = 300,
  width = 14.5,
  height = 6.5,
  units = "in",
  compression = "lzw"
)
```

```{r}
  group_by(Disease, AgeGroup) %>%
  mutate(
    prev_AAMR = lag(AAMR),
    APC = ifelse(is.na(AAMR) | is.na(prev_AAMR) | prev_AAMR <= 0,
                 NA_real_,
                 100 * (AAMR / prev_AAMR - 1))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(AgeGroup %in% c("20–44", "45–64", "65+")) %>%
  mutate(
    Disease  = factor(Disease, levels = c("AKI", "AKI/sepsis", "Sepsis")),
    AgeGroup = factor(AgeGroup, levels = c("20–44", "45–64", "65+"))
  )

# -----------------------------
# 2) Shading bands (pandemic + transition)
# -----------------------------
band_light <- tibble(xmin = 2020, xmax = 2023, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)  # 2020–2022
band_dark  <- tibble(xmin = 2023, xmax = 2024, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf)  # 2023

# Colors to match your example
age_cols <- c(
  "20–44" = "#1B9E77",
  "45–64" = "#D95F02",
  "65+"   = "#7570B3"
)

# -----------------------------
# 3) Function to make ONE disease plot (with labels)
# -----------------------------
make_one_disease_apc_plot <- function(apc_df,
                                      disease_name,
                                      label_years = c(2020, 2021, 2022),
                                      ylim_pad = 5) {

  ddf <- apc_df %>% filter(Disease == disease_name)

  # dynamic y-limits (keeps the plot looking like your example)
  y_rng <- range(ddf$APC, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_lim <- c(floor(y_rng[1] - ylim_pad), ceiling(y_rng[2] + ylim_pad))

  # label only chosen years (keeps readable)
  label_df <- ddf %>%
    filter(YearKey %in% label_years, !is.na(APC)) %>%
    mutate(lbl = sprintf("%.1f", APC))

  ggplot(ddf, aes(x = YearKey, y = APC, color = AgeGroup, group = AgeGroup)) +
    geom_rect(
      data = band_light,
      aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = "grey90",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_rect(
      data = band_dark,
      aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      fill = "grey80",
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey55") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
    geom_point(size = 3.4) +
    geom_text(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = lbl),
      show.legend = FALSE,
      color = "black",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 4.2,
      vjust = -0.8
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = age_cols) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(2010, 2025),
      breaks = seq(2010, 2025, by = 3)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_lim) +
    labs(
      title = disease_name,
      x = "Year",
      y = "Annual percent change (APC, %)",
      color = "Age group",
      caption = "Light grey: COVID-19 pandemic (2020–2022); darker grey: transition year (2023)."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
      axis.text    = element_text(color = "grey30", size = 14),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    )
}

# -----------------------------
# 4) Make + save individual plots
# -----------------------------
diseases <- c("AKI", "AKI/sepsis", "Sepsis")

plots <- lapply(diseases, function(d) make_one_disease_apc_plot(apc_long, d))

names(plots) <- diseases

# Print one (example)
plots[["AKI/sepsis"]]

# Export all as 300-dpi TIFF
for (d in diseases) {
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("Figures/Fig_APC_yoy_", str_replace_all(d, "[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_"), "_300dpi.tiff"),
    plot = plots[[d]],
    device = "tiff",
    dpi = 300,
    width = 12,
    height = 6,
    units = "in",
    compression = "lzw"
  )
}
```

# Join point
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(broom)
})

# -----------------------------
# 1) Convert wide aamr_tbl -> long with Disease + AgeGroup
# -----------------------------
aamr_long <- aamr_tbl %>%
  mutate(YearKey = as.integer(YearKey)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -YearKey,
    names_to = "series",
    values_to = "AAMR"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Disease = case_when(
      str_starts(series, "AKI_Sepsis_") ~ "AKI/sepsis",
      str_starts(series, "AKI_")        ~ "AKI",
      str_starts(series, "Sepsis_")     ~ "Sepsis",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    AgeGroup = case_when(
      str_ends(series, "_lt20")    ~ "<20",
      str_ends(series, "_20_44")   ~ "20–44",
      str_ends(series, "_45_64")   ~ "45–64",
      str_ends(series, "_65_plus") ~ "65+",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Disease), !is.na(AgeGroup)) %>%
  filter(YearKey >= 2010, YearKey <= 2025) %>%
  arrange(Disease, AgeGroup, YearKey)

# -----------------------------
# 2) Fit log-linear model and compute APC + 95% CI
#    ln(AAMR) = a + b*Year
#    APC = 100*(exp(b)-1)
# -----------------------------
fit_single_apc <- function(df) {
  d <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(AAMR), AAMR > 0) %>%           # must be >0 for log
    mutate(ln_rate = log(AAMR))

  if (nrow(d) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(d$YearKey) < 3) {
    return(tibble(
      n_years = nrow(d),
      start_year = ifelse(nrow(d) > 0, min(d$YearKey), NA_integer_),
      end_year   = ifelse(nrow(d) > 0, max(d$YearKey), NA_integer_),
      APC = NA_real_,
      APC_low = NA_real_,
      APC_high = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  m <- lm(ln_rate ~ YearKey, data = d)
  b <- coef(m)[["YearKey"]]

  # 95% CI for slope -> transform to APC CI
  ci_b <- confint(m, "YearKey", level = 0.95)
  tibble(
    n_years = nrow(d),
    start_year = min(d$YearKey),
    end_year   = max(d$YearKey),
    APC = 100 * (exp(b) - 1),
    APC_low  = 100 * (exp(ci_b[1]) - 1),
    APC_high = 100 * (exp(ci_b[2]) - 1)
  )
}

apc_joinpoint_single <- aamr_long %>%
  group_by(Disease, AgeGroup) %>%
  group_modify(~ fit_single_apc(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    APC_CI = ifelse(
      is.na(APC),
      NA_character_,
      sprintf("%.2f (%.2f to %.2f)", APC, APC_low, APC_high)
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Disease, AgeGroup)

apc_joinpoint_single
```
```{r}
apc_table_pub <- apc_joinpoint_single %>%
  transmute(
    Disease,
    AgeGroup,
    Years = ifelse(is.na(start_year), NA_character_,
                   paste0(start_year, "–", end_year)),
    n_years,
    `APC (95% CI)` = APC_CI
  )
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Export apc_table_pub (nice formatted table) + apc_wide (wide APC)
# to a Word (.docx)
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(officer)
  library(flextable)
  library(dplyr)
})

dir.create("Tables", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- sanity checks (optional but helpful) ----
stopifnot(exists("apc_table_pub"))
stopifnot(exists("apc_wide"))

# Make sure YearKey is first in apc_wide (nice for Word)
apc_wide_out <- apc_wide %>%
  mutate(YearKey = as.integer(YearKey)) %>%
  relocate(YearKey)

# ---- flextables ----
ft1 <- flextable(apc_table_pub) %>%
  autofit() %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  align(align = "left", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all")

ft2 <- flextable(apc_wide_out) %>%
  autofit() %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all")

# Optional: repeat header row on each page
ft1 <- set_table_properties(ft1, layout = "autofit")
ft2 <- set_table_properties(ft2, layout = "autofit")

# ---- build Word doc ----
doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_par("Table Sx. Joinpoint-style APC (single-slope) by disease and age group", style = "heading 1") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft1) %>%
  body_add_par("", style = "Normal") %>%
  body_add_par("Table Sy. Year-to-year APC (wide format)", style = "heading 1") %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft2)

# ---- save ----
out_file <- "tables/APC_Tables.docx"
print(doc, target = out_file)

out_file
```
